strings.en: Skin thickness and absorption vary by site, determining the potency choice:

strings.zh: 需要。先擦類固醇等吸收 5-10 分鐘，再擦保濕霜在整個區域。或反過來：先保濕、等吸收，再點擦類固醇於病灶 — 兩種方法都可以。
strings.en: Yes. Apply corticosteroid first, wait 5–10 minutes for absorption, then apply moisturizer over the entire area. Or reverse: moisturizer first, wait, then dab corticosteroid on lesions — both work.

strings.zh: 不要因為網路上的恐怖故事就擅自停藥 — 大多數正確醫療使用的人從不出問題。有疑慮就帶藥膏盒去問皮膚科醫師，他會告訴你目前用的強度與你的病況是否合適。
strings.en: Don't stop your medication based on internet horror stories — most patients on correct medical regimens never have problems. If concerned, bring the cream tube to your dermatologist, who can confirm whether the strength matches your condition.

strings.zh: 急性期超過 4 週仍未改善 → 重新評估診斷，或升級到 TCI / 光療 / 全身性藥
strings.en: If acute flare hasn't improved after 4 weeks → reassess diagnosis or step up to TCI / phototherapy / systemic agents
